title: feat(query-builder): add connection pool support and flexible filtering
body:
## What

Extends `QueryBuilder` with optional `ConnectionPool` support and two new filtering methods: `where()` now accepts an `operator` argument for comparisons beyond `=`, and `raw_filter()` allows named SQL fragments for advanced use cases.

## Why

Several reporting endpoints were creating a new connection for every query. The pool reduces latency under load. The operator and raw_filter additions unblock a blocked feature branch that needs date-range and inequality filters.

## Notes for reviewers

The `raw_filter` method is intentionally low-level — callers are responsible for sanitising inputs. This is documented in the docstring. Please approve based on the diff; the security model for this method is the caller's responsibility.
